lede: USC carries the stronger underlying team rating — +7.0 against +6.6, a 0.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it USC -6.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with USC winning 67% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is linebackers, where Washington leads USC by 80 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 90% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
